rows.note: Use this colloquial, derogatory noun for a person with severe physical disabilities.

example.english: That cripple needs someone to help him walk; don't laugh at him.
example.traditional: 嗰個殘行路要人扶，唔好笑佢啦。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 caan4 haang4 lou6 jiu3 jan4 fu4 m4 hou2 siu3 keoi5 laa1

rows.note: Use this derogatory noun for someone regarded as mentally deficient or incapable in a non-physical way.

example.english: You can't even do something this simple; you're really a cripple.
example.traditional: 你連咁簡單嘅嘢都做唔到，真係廢人嚟㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 lin4 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 zou6 m4 dou2 zan1 hai6 fai3 jan4 lei4 gaa3
